---
description: "Use when adding a new router, service, repository, schema, or model file. Enforces the correct layer placement for all backend code."
applyTo: "backend/app/**/*.py"
---

Before adding or editing any backend module, read the full guardrails:
- docs/standards/architecture_guardrails.md

That file is the single source of truth for layer rules, module layout, and file size limits.
